BiblicalUsage: Gabluth is a twisted chain or lace, the wreathen work of pure gold on the high priest's breastplate. Moses is told to make chains at the ends of wreathen work in Exodus 28:22, and the workmen made them exactly so in Exodus 39:15. The word is a craftsman's word, describing gold twisted into a pattern.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God cares about the details of worship, down to the twist of a gold chain; the breastplate carried the names of Israel over Aaron's heart, and I hold that the God who orders gold chains also orders our lives with care.
